title: Callback Button
text: Execute MATLAB code using button, {Text} sets Button label text ’Callback; {Button Type} sets the button response, {Lock Aspect Ratio} sets the option to maintain block aspect ratio, {ClickFcn} sets the mATLAB code that executes in response to click MATLAB, {PressFcn} sets the mATLAB code that executes in response to press MATLAB, {Press Delay (ms)} sets the time to hold button for press, {Repeat Interval (ms)} sets the time interval to repeat PressFcn code, {Select State} sets the selection of state, {Color} sets the label font color, {Horizontal Alignment} sets the horizontal alignment of label and icon pair with block, {Vertical Alignment} sets the vertical alignment of label and icon pair with block, {Icon and Label X Offset} sets the horizontal offset of icon and label pair, {Icon and Label Y Offset} sets the vertical offset of icon and label pair, {Icon Placement} sets the placement of icon relative, {Icon Width} sets the icon width scalar, {Icon Height} sets the icon height scalar, {Image X Offset} sets the horizontal offset of left edge of image from left edge of block, {Image Y Offset} sets the vertical offset of top edge of image from top edge of block, {Image Width} sets the image width scalar, {Image Height} sets the image height scalar, {Use Background Color} sets the option to specify solid background color, {Opacity} sets the button background opacity, {Corner Radius} sets the corner radius of area with button background color, {X Offset} sets the horizontal offset of left edge of foreground image from left edge of block, {Y Offset} sets the vertical offset of top edge of foreground image from top edge of block, {Width} sets the foreground image width scalar and {Height} sets the foreground image height scalar. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Button Type
params.values: Button response to click Momentary (default) | Latch

params.name: Text
params.values: Button label text ’Callback Button’ (default) | string | character array

params.name: Lock Aspect Ratio
params.values: Option to maintain block aspect ratio on (default) | off

params.name: ClickFcn
params.values: MATLAB code that executes in response to click MATLAB code

params.name: PressFcn
params.values: MATLAB code that executes in response to press MATLAB code

params.name: Press Delay (ms)
params.values: Time to hold button for press 500 (default) | scalar

params.name: Repeat Interval (ms)
params.values: Time interval to repeat PressFcn code 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Select State
params.values: Selection of state to configure Default (default) | Pressed | Latched | Latched and Pressed

params.name: Color
params.values: Label font color [r g b] vector

params.name: Horizontal Alignment
params.values: Horizontal alignment of label and icon pair with block Left (default) | Center | Right

params.name: Vertical Alignment
params.values: Vertical alignment of label and icon pair with block Center (default) | Bottom | Top

params.name: Icon and Label X Offset
params.values: Horizontal offset of icon and label pair from block 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Icon and Label Y Offset
params.values: Vertical offset of icon and label pair from block 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Icon Placement
params.values: Placement of icon relative to label Left (default) | Top | Right | Bottom

params.name: Icon Width
params.values: Icon width scalar

params.name: Icon Height
params.values: Icon height scalar

params.name: Image X Offset
params.values: Horizontal offset of left edge of image from left edge of block scalar

params.name: Image Y Offset
params.values: Vertical offset of top edge of image from top edge of block scalar

params.name: Image Width
params.values: Image width scalar

params.name: Image Height
params.values: Image height scalar

params.name: Use Background Color
params.values: Option to specify solid background color for button on (default) | off

params.name: Opacity
params.values: Button background opacity 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Corner Radius
params.values: Corner radius of area with button background color scalar

params.name: X Offset
params.values: Horizontal offset of left edge of foreground image from left edge of block scalar

params.name: Y Offset
params.values: Vertical offset of top edge of foreground image from top edge of block scalar

params.name: Width
params.values: Foreground image width scalar
